infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: SmartNeb requires Bluetooth access to discover and pair your nebulizer device and stream live respiratory vitals.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: SmartNeb requires Bluetooth to connect to your portable nebulizer.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SmartNeb requires camera access to scan medication barcodes and ampoules for prescription verification.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SmartNeb requires microphone access for telehealth video consultations with your pediatrician.
